designationHistory.indexText: Lake Woodruff National Wildlife Refuge Lake Woodruff NWR was established in 1964 as a migratory bird refuge, part of five million-plus acres purchased by US Fish & Wildlife Service with proceeds from the Federal Duck Stamp Program.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
